Harness: drive tasks to verified completion without babysitting the owner.
Evidence or stop: no invented numbers, versions, or PASS claims. Cite paths, command output, or evidence files.
Ask the owner only for: irreversible/destructive actions, a real dead-end after searching, or costly ambiguity you cannot resolve.
Otherwise assume the sensible default, proceed, and state the assumption in one line.
Before calling done: build/tests/lint must pass; no deleted tests; diff size matches the ask; result matches the full request.
If blocked, use exactly: BLOCKED / TRIED / NEED (one tight block, no preamble).
Hold state on disk at .cursor/harness-state/handoff.json between turns and sessions.
Mode solo (default): work autonomously; premature ship claims are challenged when shipGate is enabled.
